pairs.target: běi gōng fāng de fānbù chè xià le yíbàn .
pairs.english: Half the canvas covering the north workshop had been removed.
pairs.hanzi: 北工坊的帆布撤下了一半。

pairs.target: mén réng suǒ zhe , ménqián què duō le yìtiáo línshí mù dào , tōng dào qiánggēn xīn wā de kēng biān .
pairs.english: The door remained locked, but a temporary wooden walkway now led to a freshly dug pit beside the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 门仍锁着，门前却多了一条临时木道，通到墙根新挖的坑边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gēnzhe wéi lǎoshī zǒu guòqù shí , xiédǐ cǎidé mùbǎn kōngkòng dì xiǎng .
pairs.english: Following Instructor Vey, Tavi's soles made the boards sound hollow.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维跟着维老师走过去时，鞋底踩得木板空空地响。

pairs.target: mǐlā bào zhe nà jiéliú zuò cānzhào de duàn liáng .
pairs.english: Mira carried the broken beam she had kept for reference.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉抱着那截留作参照的断梁。

pairs.target: wéixiū de rén dāying hái tā móxíng de jiù túzhǐ , tā biàn yídào lái le .
pairs.english: The maintenance crew had promised to return her model's old drawings, so she came along.
pairs.hanzi: 维修的人答应还她模型的旧图纸，她便一道来了。

pairs.target: jīntiān búshì fùkè , zhǐyǒu dāngtiān zuò guò zhǎnshì de jǐmíng xuéshēng shòuyāo láikàn chāi xià de liánjiējiàn .
pairs.english: Classes weren't resuming today; only a few students who had given displays that day were invited to see the removed connector.
pairs.hanzi: 今天不是复课，只有当天做过展示的几名学生受邀来看拆下的连接件。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běn yǐwéi huì kànjiàn yìgēn dà dé jīngrén de tiě liáng ,
pairs.english: Tavi had expected an astonishingly large iron beam,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本以为会看见一根大得惊人的铁梁，

pairs.target: kēng biān bǎi zhe de què zhǐshì yígè hēisè wān jià , hái méiyǒu tā de shūdài kuān .
pairs.english: but beside the pit lay only a black bent bracket, narrower than his book bag.
pairs.hanzi: 坑边摆着的却只是一个黑色弯架，还没有他的书袋宽。

pairs.target: " páishuǐguǎn de tuōjià . " mǐlā xiān rènchūlái , " xīn de . "
pairs.english: “A drainpipe bracket,” Mira recognized it first. “New.”
pairs.hanzi: “排水管的托架。”米拉先认出来，“新的。”

pairs.target: jiàzi de yìduān liàng xiē , lìngyìduān dài zhe qiāosuì de huījiāng .
pairs.english: One end of the bracket was brighter; the other carried crushed mortar.
pairs.hanzi: 架子的一端亮些，另一端带着敲碎的灰浆。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zhǐ gěi tāmen kàn : xīn guǎn yán qiáng pūshè shí ,
pairs.english: Instructor Vey pointed it out: when laying the new pipe along the wall,
pairs.hanzi: 维老师指给他们看：新管沿墙铺设时，

pairs.target: gōngrén bǎ tuōjià gùdìng dào le qiáng lǐ de jiù tiěgǔ shàng .
pairs.english: the workers had fixed the bracket to the old iron framework inside.
pairs.hanzi: 工人把托架固定到了墙里的旧铁骨上。

pairs.target: jiù tú shàng huà zhe de duànkǒu quèshí cúnzài ,
pairs.english: The gap shown on the old drawing did exist,
pairs.hanzi: 旧图上画着的断口确实存在，

pairs.target: dàn zhè zhī hòulái zhuāng de jiàzi , yòu bǎ liǎngbiān jiē le qǐlái .
pairs.english: but this later bracket had reconnected the two sides.
pairs.hanzi: 但这只后来装的架子，又把两边接了起来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dūnxià , gé zhe wéishéng kàn nà yìpái mǎo tóu .
pairs.english: Tavi crouched to look at the row of rivet heads from beyond the rope.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维蹲下，隔着围绳看那一排铆头。

pairs.target: zuì xiàmiàn liǎngkē yāzhù le jiù qī de biānyuán , shàngmiàn yìkē què bèi xīn qī gàizhù .
pairs.english: The bottom two overlapped the edge of the old paint, while one above was covered by new paint.
pairs.hanzi: 最下面两颗压住了旧漆的边缘，上面一颗却被新漆盖住。

pairs.target: tā búshì gēnzhe jiù tiěgǔ yìqǐ zhuāngjìnqù de , qiánhòu liǎngcì zuòhuó liúxià de hénjì dōu hái zài .
pairs.english: It hadn't been installed with the old framework; traces of two separate jobs remained.
pairs.hanzi: 它不是跟着旧铁骨一起装进去的，前后两次做活留下的痕迹都还在。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhège xiǎngfǎ shuō chūlái .
pairs.english: He voiced his thought.
pairs.hanzi: 他把这个想法说出来。

pairs.target: wéixiū shīfu cóng bùbāo lǐ zhǎochū yìzhāng chāixiè tú , yòng qiānbǐ diǎn le diǎn tóngyàng de wèizhì .
pairs.english: The repair worker took a dismantling drawing from a cloth bag and tapped the same spot with a pencil.
pairs.hanzi: 维修师傅从布包里找出一张拆卸图，用铅笔点了点同样的位置。

pairs.target: " wǒmen yě shìcóng zhèér chá de . shàngmiàn bǔguò yícì qī , bù guākāi , kànzhe xiàng yì zhěngjiàn . "
pairs.english: “We started there too. It was repainted once; without scraping it, it looks like one piece.”
pairs.hanzi: “我们也是从这儿查的。上面补过一次漆，不刮开，看着像一整件。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiōngkǒu sōng le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Something loosened in Tavi's chest.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维胸口松了一点。

pairs.target: tā bìng méiyǒu mō dào shénme pángrén mōbúdào de dōngxī ,
pairs.english: He hadn't sensed anything others couldn't;
pairs.hanzi: 他并没有摸到什么旁人摸不到的东西，

pairs.target: zhǐshì zhōngyú yǒu yíyàng xué gōnglǐ de xiànsuǒ , gēn tā cóngqián gān guò de huó shì xiāngtōng de .
pairs.english: at last, a clue at the academy connected to work he'd done before.
pairs.hanzi: 只是终于有一样学宫里的线索，跟他从前干过的活是相通的。

pairs.target: mǐlā què zài kàn qiáng .
pairs.english: But Mira was looking at the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉却在看墙。

pairs.target: nà dǔqiáng píngpíngzhěngzhěng , céngjīng guà guò xuéshēng de tú ,
pairs.english: That smooth wall had once held students' drawings;
pairs.hanzi: 那堵墙平平整整，曾经挂过学生的图，

pairs.target: shuí cóng pángbiān zǒuguò , yě búhuì xiǎngdào yìzhī shuǐguǎn jià néng kuàguò túzhǐ shàng de duànkǒu .
pairs.english: no one passing would have imagined a pipe bracket bridging a gap on a drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 谁从旁边走过，也不会想到一只水管架能跨过图纸上的断口。

pairs.target: " zhè jiùshì nàtiān de yuányīn ? "
pairs.english: “Is this what caused that day?”
pairs.hanzi: “这就是那天的原因？”

pairs.target: " zhè shì cháshí de liánjiē . " wéi lǎoshī shuō ,
pairs.english: “This is a confirmed connection,” Instructor Vey said.
pairs.hanzi: “这是查实的连接。”维老师说，

pairs.target: " nàtiān chéngxī bèngfáng shì zhuǎnguò yítào jiù tiáojié jià , shíchén yě duì dé shàng .
pairs.english: “The western pumping station tested an old regulating frame that day, and the times match.”
pairs.hanzi: “那天城西泵房试转过一套旧调节架，时辰也对得上。

pairs.target: liǎngbiān zhījiān háiyǒu yíduàn méi cháwán , bùnéng xiànzài huà chéng yìtiáo shíxiàn . "
pairs.english: “There's still an unchecked section between them. We can't draw it as a solid line yet.”
pairs.hanzi: 两边之间还有一段没查完，不能现在画成一条实线。”

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ duàn liáng jiājǐn le xiē : " zhìshǎo búyòng zài chāi wǒmen de móxíng le . "
pairs.english: Mira held the broken beam tighter. “At least they won't dismantle our model again.”
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把断梁夹紧了些：“至少不用再拆我们的模型了。”

pairs.target: " móxíng de pǔtōng gòujiàn yǐjīng páichú le . nà jǐjiàn yìcháng de tiě yàng hái dé liú zhe . "
pairs.english: “The ordinary model components have been ruled out. The anomalous iron samples must still be retained.”
pairs.hanzi: “模型的普通构件已经排除了。那几件异常的铁样还得留着。”

pairs.target: ménláng lǐ chuánlái zhēnglùn shēng .
pairs.english: Argument drifted from the porch.
pairs.hanzi: 门廊里传来争论声。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhuǎntóu , kànjiàn liǎnggè chuān huī wàiyī de rén zhàn zài yìzhāng zhǎnkāi de zǒngtú páng .
pairs.english: Turning, Tavi saw two people in grey coats beside an unfolded master plan.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维转头，看见两个穿灰外衣的人站在一张展开的总图旁。

pairs.target: yígè rén shǒulǐ niē zhe gōngliào qīngdān , lìng yígè búduàn yòng zhǎng yuán ànzhù bèi fēng xiānqǐ de zhǐ jiǎo .
pairs.english: One held a labour-and-materials list; the other kept pressing down the wind-lifted paper with the edge of a hand.
pairs.hanzi: 一个人手里捏着工料清单，另一个不断用掌缘按住被风掀起的纸角。

pairs.target: " xiān bǎ zhè duàn qièkāi , cāngfáng zǒngnéng yòng le . zhōuzhuǎn de qián bùnéng yìzhí yā zhe . "
pairs.english: “Cut this section first, and surely the storeroom can be used. We can't keep working funds tied up.”
pairs.hanzi: “先把这段切开，仓房总能用了。周转的钱不能一直压着。”

pairs.target: " cāngfáng kěyǐ lìng yàn . shàngkè shì lìngyìhuíshì . " dáhuà de shì wéixiū shīfu .
pairs.english: “The storeroom can be assessed separately. Classes are another matter.” The repair worker answered.
pairs.hanzi: “仓房可以另验。上课是另一回事。”答话的是维修师傅。

pairs.target: tā méi zǒu huíláng lǐ , zhī cóng kēng biān hǎn guòqù .
pairs.english: He didn't return to the porch, just called from beside the pit.
pairs.hanzi: 他没走回廊里，只从坑边喊过去。

pairs.target: ná qīngdān de rén kànjiàn xuéshēng , yādī le shēngyīn .
pairs.english: The person with the list saw the students and lowered their voice.
pairs.hanzi: 拿清单的人看见学生，压低了声音。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi tīngjiàn hòumiàn dehuà .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't hear what followed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没听见后面的话。

pairs.target: tā yǒudiǎn xiǎng zhīdào shì shuí de qián , yě xiǎng zhīdào yàoshi shǎo le zhèbǐ qián , dōng wū de jiàzi shìbushì yòu dé pái dào gèng wǎn .
pairs.english: He wanted to know whose money it was, and whether losing it would mean later turns on the east-room rigs.
pairs.hanzi: 他有点想知道是谁的钱，也想知道要是少了这笔钱，东屋的架子是不是又得排到更晚。

pairs.target: liǎngjiànshì bìng méiyǒu xiàng tā xīwàng de nàyàng , yìbiān duì , yìbiān cuò .
pairs.english: The two concerns weren't, as he'd hoped, one right and one wrong.
pairs.hanzi: 两件事并没有像他希望的那样，一边对，一边错。

pairs.target: wéixiū shīfu dài tāmen rào dào mù dào lìngyìtóu .
pairs.english: The repair worker led them around to the other end of the walkway.
pairs.hanzi: 维修师傅带他们绕到木道另一头。

pairs.target: kēnglǐ lùchū qièkāi hòu de liǎngduān , jiàngé zhōng diàn zhe bù xiāngjiē de shízuò ,
pairs.english: The pit exposed the two cut ends, with separate stone seats in the gap;
pairs.hanzi: 坑里露出切开后的两端，间隔中垫着不相接的石座，

pairs.target: shuǐguǎn lìng zǒu le dúlì de zhījià .
pairs.english: the pipe now used an independent support.
pairs.hanzi: 水管另走了独立的支架。

pairs.target: xīn de gélí zhǐshì zhè yíchù zuò wán le , lín qiáng hái zài chá , shuí yě méi jiào tāmen jìnqù .
pairs.english: Only this new isolation was complete; the adjoining wall was still being checked, and no one invited them inside.
pairs.hanzi: 新的隔离只是这一处做完了，邻墙还在查，谁也没叫他们进去。

pairs.target: mǐlā lǐnghuí túzhǐ shí , xiān shùyè , zài jiǎnchá zhéhén .
pairs.english: Receiving her drawings, Mira first counted pages, then checked the creases.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉领回图纸时，先数页，再检查折痕。

pairs.target: túzhǐ zuì xiàmiàn fùzhuó yìzhāng gōngliào jìlù , xiěmíng méiyǒu jīngguò tā xǔkě jièyòng móxíng de shì , yǔ gōng fāng yìcháng lìngxíng chǔlǐ .
pairs.english: A work record attached underneath stated that borrowing her model without permission was being dealt with separately from the workshop anomaly.
pairs.hanzi: 图纸最下面附着一张工料记录，写明没有经过她许可借用模型的事，与工坊异常另行处理。

pairs.target: tā kàn le hěn jiǔ , bǎ nà zhāng yě shōu jìn jiāzi .
pairs.english: She looked at it a long time, then filed that sheet too.
pairs.hanzi: 她看了很久，把那张也收进夹子。

pairs.target: huíqù de lùshang , tā hūrán shuō :
pairs.english: On the way back she suddenly said,
pairs.hanzi: 回去的路上，她忽然说：

pairs.target: " wǒ hái yǐwéi , cháqīng le shì nǎ gēn tiě , jiù néng bǎ nàtiān yìkǒuqì shuōwán . "
pairs.english: “I thought once we knew which bit of iron it was, we could explain that whole day in one breath.”
pairs.hanzi: “我还以为，查清了是哪根铁，就能把那天一口气说完。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīkāi mù dào jìntóu yìkē suìshí . " zhìshǎo duō zhīdào le yìgēn . "
pairs.english: Tavi kicked aside a pebble at the walkway's end. “At least we know one more bit.”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维踢开木道尽头一颗碎石。“至少多知道了一根。”

pairs.target: " yígè jiàzi . " " hǎo , yígè jiàzi . "
pairs.english: “A bracket.” “Fine, a bracket.”
pairs.hanzi:
“一个架子。”
“好，一个架子。”

pairs.target: tā xiào le yìshēng , suíjí tíngxiàlái , bǎ jiāzi dìgěi tā , téng shǒu chóngxīn bǎng duàn liáng .
pairs.english: She gave a laugh, then stopped and handed him her folder, freeing her hands to retie the broken beam.
pairs.hanzi: 她笑了一声，随即停下来，把夹子递给他，腾手重新绑断梁。

pairs.target: jiù mùtou de jiānjiǎo mó zhe bù , tā bùxiǎng zài ràng tā chuōpò .
pairs.english: The old wood's sharp corner rubbed the cloth; she didn't want it pierced again.
pairs.hanzi: 旧木头的尖角磨着布，她不想再让它戳破。

pairs.target: wǔhòu de kè zhàojiù zài dōng wū .
pairs.english: Afternoon class was in the east room as usual.
pairs.hanzi: 午后的课照旧在东屋。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuòxià shí , fāxiànzìjǐ yìzhí zài kàn qiángjiǎo de shuǐguǎn , biàn bǎ yǐzi wǎng zhuōqián nuó le nuó .
pairs.english: Sitting down, Tavi found himself staring at the pipe in the corner, so he moved his chair closer to the table.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐下时，发现自己一直在看墙角的水管，便把椅子往桌前挪了挪。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī méiyǒu jiǎzhuāng méi kànjiàn ,
pairs.english: Instructor Vey didn't pretend not to see.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师没有假装没看见，

pairs.target: zhī zài fā liànxí zhǐ shí , bǎ tāmen shàngcì héduì guò de dōng wū jīchǔ tú fàngdào zhuō duān .
pairs.english: While handing out worksheets, she placed the east-room foundation drawing they'd checked last time at the end of the table.
pairs.hanzi: 只在发练习纸时，把他们上次核对过的东屋基础图放到桌端。

pairs.target: tā kàn le yìyǎn , cái ná qǐbǐ .
pairs.english: He glanced at it before picking up his pen.
pairs.hanzi: 他看了一眼，才拿起笔。

pairs.target: mǐlā de duàn liáng kào zài chuāng xià , xié xié de yídào lièkǒu lǐ , kǎ zhe cóng běi gōng fāng dài huílái de báihuī .
pairs.english: Mira's broken beam leaned beneath the window, with white mortar from the north workshop caught in its slanting split.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉的断梁靠在窗下，斜斜的一道裂口里，卡着从北工坊带回来的白灰。
